name: page-to-figma
description: Send Claude artifacts, HTML and web pages into Figma as editable layers.
long_description:
Say "send this to Figma" in a chat and the artifact arrives in your open Figma file as real layers: frames, live text, Auto Layout, components and styles. Works with React and HTML artifacts, any HTML file on your computer, and public web pages. Name a page or screen ("send the Payment screen to Figma") to import just that part, and the plugin asks before replacing a frame that is already there.

Needs the free Page to Figma plugin open in Figma desktop. Everything stays on your computer: pages go to Figma through a small relay on localhost:7801, which this extension starts when needed.

tools.name: send_to_figma
tools.description: Send a React or HTML artifact, an HTML file or a web page into Figma as editable layers.
